## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Ocean Shores, Australia. It starts at 81 Monet Drive.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Set sail on a relaxing journey to Byron, The Crystal Castle, and the Shambhala Gardens. Located at the Byron Bay Hinterland, this sanctuary offers tranquility atop a beautiful valley of crystals.
>
> Explore some of the world's most unique crystals and plunge into the magic of the world's largest amethyst cave. Then, roam through the Shambhala Gardens, home to an ancient labyrinth and a sacred Buddha.
>
> Don't forget to stop by the Kalachakra World Peace Stupa, personally blessed by his holiness, the Dalai Lama.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €35.88. It was rated 3.8 out of 5 from 4 ratings and 4 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
